description: Telnyx AI text-inference provider plugin for Hermes

summary.one_liner: A copy-only Hermes Agent plugin that registers Telnyx's AI text-inference API as an OpenAI-compatible chat-completions model provider, without a LiteLLM proxy.
summary.what_it_does: The repository contains a provider plugin for Hermes Agent under plugins/model-providers/telnyx. Once copied into ~/.hermes/plugins/model-providers/, it registers the provider ID "telnyx" with aliases "telnyx-ai" and "telnyx-intelligence". Hermes then sends requests to Telnyx's OpenAI-compatible /chat/completions endpoint using the TELNYX_API_KEY environment variable. TELNYX_BASE_URL can override the base URL for a non-production Telnyx-compatible endpoint. The plugin ships a static fallback model catalog (for example openai/gpt-5.2, anthropic/claude-haiku-4-5, google/gemini-2.5-flash, and Qwen/Qwen3-235B-A22B) for offline model picking, and prefers the live /models endpoint when reachable. The test suite covers manifest/provider shape and a runtime import smoke test using stubbed Hermes APIs.
use_cases: Use Telnyx-hosted models inside the Hermes Agent chat CLI
Access OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and open-weight models through one Telnyx API key
Register a custom model provider in Hermes without a LiteLLM proxy
Offline model picker with a static fallback catalog
Test a Telnyx-compatible inference endpoint via base URL override
notable: Connects directly to the Telnyx AI API, with no LiteLLM proxy in between
Installation is a file copy; pip install is not needed
Static fallback model catalog for offline use, with live /models preferred when available
caveats: Requires an existing Hermes Agent installation; this repo does not install Hermes
Requires a Telnyx API key with access to Telnyx AI text inference
Requires Python 3.10+ for local development and tests
